description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM Lock Pull Tab and Grommet.
The Lock Pull Tab screws onto the lock lever rod that protrudes out the top of the door and the Grommet snaps into the lock rod hole.
Simple to install and does BOTH door locks!
COLOR: Black
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Door Lock Knob
Qty 2 – Grommet, Lock Knob
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1994 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1994 – 1995 All Models
